verdict.label: Light review
verdict.summary: Create a Google Cloud project, configure OAuth consent, and set up your redirect URI from the Composio dashboard to connect Gmail.

composioFit.summary: Composio supports both managed auth and custom auth configs for Gmail, allowing you to use Composio's shared app or provide your own OAuth app for custom branding, scopes, and quotas.
whyOwnApp: You need your own app name on OAuth consent screens.
You're hitting rate limits on the shared managed app quota.
You're connecting to a custom instance.

phases.name: Create Google Cloud Project & Enable APIs
steps: Enable the APIs you want to use in the Google Cloud console.
phases.handoff: Google Cloud console project created and APIs enabled.

phases.name: Configure OAuth Consent & Credentials
steps: Configure OAuth consent settings in the Google Cloud console.
Create access credentials for your end users.
Add the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard into your OAuth app settings.
Copy Client ID and Client Secret back into Composio.
phases.handoff: Client ID and Client Secret entered into the Composio dashboard.

artefacts.title: OAuth App Configuration Values
artefacts.body:
Application Name: Your App Name
Authorized Redirect URI: <Composio callback URL from your auth config>

requirements.label: Privacy Policy
requirements.when: Required when publishing public OAuth applications requesting sensitive scopes

redirectRules.rule: Must use the exact redirect URI provided in the Composio dashboard auth config.

blockers.cause: The authorization request is missing the required scope parameter.
blockers.fix: Include the required scope parameter in your authorization URL request.
blockers.fallback: Use Composio-managed app which handles scopes automatically.

checklist.text: Enable Gmail and required Workspace APIs.
Get the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard auth config.
Add the redirect URI and create Client ID and Client Secret.
Enter Client ID and Client Secret into the Composio dashboard.

uncertainties: Exact Google OAuth verification turnaround time for production custom apps is not specified in the sources.
Exact refresh token lifetime limits for custom Gmail OAuth apps are not detailed in the provided documentation.
